name: signalscope
description: Browser-class signal analyzer with native C++ DSP backend

scripts.build:ui: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/ && esbuild src/renderer/index.jsx --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/bundle.js --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\"
scripts.dev:ui: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/ && esbuild src/renderer/index.jsx --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/bundle.js --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\"
scripts.build:backend:pocketfft:uws: cmake -B build/backend-pocketfft-uws         -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=OFF -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=OFF && cmake --build build/backend-pocketfft-uws         --config Release
scripts.build:backend:pocketfft:simple-ws: cmake -B build/backend-pocketfft-simple-ws   -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=OFF -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=ON  && cmake --build build/backend-pocketfft-simple-ws   --config Release
scripts.build:backend:fftw:uws: cmake -B build/backend-fftw-uws              -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=ON  -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=OFF && cmake --build build/backend-fftw-uws              --config Release
scripts.build:backend:fftw:simple-ws: cmake -B build/backend-fftw-simple-ws        -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=ON  -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=ON  && cmake --build build/backend-fftw-simple-ws        --config Release
scripts.build:backend:fftw-static:uws: cmake -B build/backend-fftw-static-uws       -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=ON  -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=ON  -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=OFF && cmake --build build/backend-fftw-static-uws       --config Release
scripts.build:backend:fftw-static:simple-ws: cmake -B build/backend-fftw-static-simple-ws -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=ON  -DUSE_KFR=OFF -DSTATIC_FFTW=ON  -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=ON  && cmake --build build/backend-fftw-static-simple-ws --config Release
scripts.build:backend:kfr:uws: cmake -B build/backend-kfr-uws               -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=OFF -DUSE_KFR=ON  -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=OFF && cmake --build build/backend-kfr-uws               --config Release
scripts.build:backend:kfr:simple-ws: cmake -B build/backend-kfr-simple-ws         -S src/backend -DUSE_FFTW=OFF -DUSE_KFR=ON  -DSTATIC_FFTW=OFF -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=ON  && cmake --build build/backend-kfr-simple-ws         --config Release
scripts.build:backend:matrix: npm run build:backend:pocketfft:uws && npm run build:backend:pocketfft:simple-ws && npm run build:backend:fftw:uws && npm run build:backend:fftw:simple-ws && npm run build:backend:fftw-static:uws && npm run build:backend:fftw-static:simple-ws && npm run build:backend:kfr:uws && npm run build:backend:kfr:simple-ws
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend:pocketfft:simple-ws && cmake -B build/tests -S tests/backend -DUSE_FFTW=OFF -DUSE_KFR=OFF && cmake --build build/tests && ctest --test-dir build/tests --output-on-failure
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:backend:matrix && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= playwright test
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:renderer
scripts.predist: npm run build:backend && npm run build:ui
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:backend             && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:linux:fftw: npm run build:backend:fftw:uws        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage   '--config.appImage.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-fftw.${ext}'
scripts.dist:linux:fftw-static: npm run build:backend:fftw-static:uws && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage   '--config.appImage.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-fftw-static.${ext}'
scripts.dist:linux:kfr: npm run build:backend:kfr:uws         && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage   '--config.appImage.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-kfr.${ext}'
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:backend             && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:win:fftw: npm run build:backend:fftw:uws        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable     '--config.portable.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-portable-fftw.${ext}'
scripts.dist:win:fftw-static: npm run build:backend:fftw-static:uws && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable     '--config.portable.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-portable-fftw-static.${ext}'
scripts.dist:win:kfr: npm run build:backend:kfr:uws         && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable     '--config.portable.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-portable-kfr.${ext}'
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:backend             && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:mac:fftw: npm run build:backend:fftw:uws        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg          '--config.dmg.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-fftw.${ext}'
scripts.dist:mac:fftw-static: npm run build:backend:fftw-static:uws && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg          '--config.dmg.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-fftw-static.${ext}'
scripts.dist:mac:kfr: npm run build:backend:kfr:uws         && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg          '--config.dmg.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-kfr.${ext}'
scripts.pack:linux: npm run dist:linux             && cmake -B build/pack-pocketfft   -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=pocketfft   && cmake --build build/pack-pocketfft   --target package
scripts.pack:linux:fftw: npm run dist:linux:fftw        && cmake -B build/pack-fftw        -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw        && cmake --build build/pack-fftw        --target package
scripts.pack:linux:fftw-static: npm run dist:linux:fftw-static && cmake -B build/pack-fftw-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw-static && cmake --build build/pack-fftw-static --target package
scripts.pack:linux:kfr: npm run dist:linux:kfr         && cmake -B build/pack-kfr         -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=kfr         && cmake --build build/pack-kfr         --target package
scripts.pack:win: npm run dist:win               && cmake -B build/pack-pocketfft   -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=pocketfft   && cmake --build build/pack-pocketfft   --target package
scripts.pack:win:fftw: npm run dist:win:fftw          && cmake -B build/pack-fftw        -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw        && cmake --build build/pack-fftw        --target package
scripts.pack:win:fftw-static: npm run dist:win:fftw-static   && cmake -B build/pack-fftw-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw-static && cmake --build build/pack-fftw-static --target package
scripts.pack:win:kfr: npm run dist:win:kfr           && cmake -B build/pack-kfr         -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=kfr         && cmake --build build/pack-kfr         --target package
scripts.pack:mac: npm run dist:mac               && cmake -B build/pack-pocketfft   -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=pocketfft   && cmake --build build/pack-pocketfft   --target package
scripts.pack:mac:fftw: npm run dist:mac:fftw          && cmake -B build/pack-fftw        -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw        && cmake --build build/pack-fftw        --target package
scripts.pack:mac:fftw-static: npm run dist:mac:fftw-static   && cmake -B build/pack-fftw-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=fftw-static && cmake --build build/pack-fftw-static --target package
scripts.pack:mac:kfr: npm run dist:mac:kfr           && cmake -B build/pack-kfr         -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=kfr         && cmake --build build/pack-kfr         --target package
